reasoning_traces.think:
The RSRM framework integrates reinforcement learning with symbolic regression by leveraging MCTS to explore expression trees and Double Q-learning to refine search space based on reward distributions. The core innovation lies in modulating sub-tree discovery to invent new composite operators from recurring motifs. This allows the system to scale beyond discrete search spaces by dynamically expanding its operator set. The method's strength stems from its ability to balance exploration (via MCTS) and exploitation (via Q-learning), while avoiding overfitting through structured pruning. However, failure modes include unstable reward estimation, overfitting to benchmark-specific motifs, and loss of true solutions due to aggressive pruning. The system assumes reward stability and meaningful sub-tree recurrence, which may not hold in high-noise or sparse data regimes.
